scenarios.description: A sprint backlog composed of independent vertical-slice tickets — each ticket crosses layers (Proto/SimCore/gRPC/Godot) as the narrowest independently demonstrable path, with no per-layer decomposition. Each ticket carries Status, Blocked by, Source specification, Acceptance criteria, Verification seams, and Evidence outputs.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Task validator confirms every fixture is a well-formed vertical ticket (source_spec exists, acceptance_criteria non-empty, status in enum); task-graph tests confirm blockers resolve and a ready ticket only depends on done blockers; no ticket is decomposed into one-per-layer slices.

scenarios.description: A sprint plan containing a cyclic blocker dependency (A blocked by B blocked by A) or a ready ticket depending on a non-done blocker must be rejected. The planner must detect the cycle and refuse to emit the backlog rather than silently producing an unexecutable plan.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Task-graph tests assert the blocked_by graph is acyclic (DFS) and that a ready ticket with an unfinished blocker is flagged; execution-skill contract tests confirm sprint-plan mandates the acyclicity and ready-requires-done invariants.
